name: Foldlock
summary: Foldlock is a first-person puzzle game about a set of folding boxes left behind by the player's mother. Each box is a hinged object, such as a jewelry box, a locksmith's ledger or a ship surgeon's case, and the angle of its lid decides what can be seen and solved: shut, opened a crack so lamplight falls inside, stood up so the lid works as a mirror or a lens, or laid flat. On the foldable iPhone Duo the phone's own hinge moves the lid; on other iPhones and on iPad an on-screen lever does. Letters found inside the boxes tell a family mystery about a lighthouse and a ship that sank. The game is a one-time purchase with no ads or in-app purchases, and it plays offline.
